Messages.Author: Ulugh Beg
Messages.Body:
Greetings , my doubt : Is possible put 2 Death Pact o more in the
same vampire ? that is vamp A play a Death pact in vamp B , Vamp C
put a Death pact in vamp B etc...
Another question is if the same vamp can have 2 death pact as
retairnes :
Vamp A put a death pact in Vamp B , vamp B is burned & the Deach Pact
Retainer is now in vamp A , Vamp A put a death pact in vamp C, Vamp C
burn & the death pact retainer is in vamp A too.

Death Pact:
This card is an action card that becomes a retainer card. +1 stealth
action. [nec] (D) Put this card on a ready vampire. If that vampire is
burned, put this card on the vampire who brought this card into play.
This card then represents a -wraith- retainer with 2 life. Once each
combat, the vampire with this retainer may change one damage from
aggravated to normal. [NEC] As above, but the retainer has 3 life.

That愀 all. Best Regards.
Francisco Rojas Jimenez v:ken Prince Of Cordoba ( Spain)
a.k.a : a spanish drunken guy ;-)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ulugh Beg wrote:
>
> Greetings , my doubt : Is possible put 2 Death Pact o more in the
> same vampire ? that is vamp A play a Death pact in vamp B , Vamp C
> put a Death pact in vamp B etc...

Yes.

> Another question is if the same vamp can have 2 death pact as
> retairnes :
> Vamp A put a death pact in Vamp B , vamp B is burned & the Deach Pact
> Retainer is now in vamp A , Vamp A put a death pact in vamp C, Vamp C
> burn & the death pact retainer is in vamp A too.

Yes.

You can even combine the two: Vamp A puts a Death Pact on vamp B and
then Vamp A puts another Death Pact on vamp B. Vamp B burns and so
vamp A gets 2 wraith retainers.
